setup.intro.description: First establish this system's persistence foundation, then create the built-in administrator and register the rule config center.

setup.nacosCredentialsRequired: Enter the Nacos username and password.
setup.noneNote: {{source}} will be connected anonymously. Use this only when network isolation, access control and TLS are already guaranteed by the deployment environment.
setup.option.consul.description: Like Nacos, an authoritative rule source; not used for account or audit storage.
setup.option.credentialReference.descrip: A secret manager, Kubernetes Secret or deployment config provides the credentials to the server.
setup.option.credentialReference.label: Use a deployment credential reference
setup.option.direct.description: For controlled intranets; credentials are submitted write-only to the backend and never shown on the page again.
setup.option.direct.label: Enter credentials in the console
setup.option.mysql.description: Production ready, requires MySQL 8.0+; MariaDB must be evaluated as a separate compatibility item.
setup.option.nacos.description: The management service publishes complete rule snapshots through a controlled write-back flow.
setup.option.none.description: Only for config centers that are isolated and explicitly allow anonymous access; TLS is still recommended.
setup.option.none.label: Disable authentication
setup.option.postgres.description: Production ready, for reliable control-plane persistence.
setup.option.sqlite.description: Local experience or single-machine development only; not for production cluster storage.

setup.stage.admin.description: This account is the first admin; the system does not generate, display or retain any default password.
setup.stage.admin.title: Create the built-in administrator
setup.stage.database.description: Accounts, roles, audit, drafts, rule versions and release plans need a relational database; active rules are still not written to it directly.
setup.stage.database.title: Configure the system database
setup.stage.finish.description: When finished, the system records the initialization state, creates the built-in administrator and opens sign-in and the console API.
setup.stage.finish.title: Confirm and finish
setup.stage.source.description: Choose the first rule source for this deployment; another source can be added later under system management.
setup.stage.source.title: Register the rule config center
setup.step.admin.description: Create the single first admin; the system provides no default password.
setup.step.admin.label: Built-in administrator
setup.step.database.description: Verify the database connection and create the control-plane schema.
setup.step.database.label: System storage
setup.step.finish.description: Record the initialization result and open sign-in and the console API.
setup.step.finish.label: Finish initialization
setup.step.source.description: Register Nacos or Consul; rules remain authoritatively held by the config center.
setup.step.source.label: Rule source
setup.warning: No authorization code is needed for first-run setup on this machine. Remote setup from a non-local address requires a one-time code supplied by the deployment operator; it is not a software license. The server never stores the database password in a plaintext file.
setup.operator.title: Authorize first-run setup
setup.operator.description: A one-time code from the deployment operator is required only when setup is opened remotely. First-run setup on this machine is authorized automatically with local-only checks. The code is not a software license and does not sign you in as an administrator.
setup.operator.closed: This Console has already been initialized or its one-time setup window is closed.
setup.operator.unknown: Do not submit the code again yet. Inspect the original authorization result first.
setup.operator.unavailable: The Console could not confirm the setup window. Retry the read; an unavailable response is not proof that setup is open.
setup.workflow.title: Initialization status
setup.workflow.idle: No initialization request has been submitted.
setup.workflow.closed: The system is initialized and setup is closed. Use the login page.
setup.workflow.submitting: Submitting initialization. Do not submit again.
setup.workflow.pending: The server is still working. Inspect the original request; do not resubmit.
setup.workflow.unknown: The outcome is unconfirmed. Inspect the original request; do not initialize again.
setup.workflow.rejected.dependency: An initialization dependency is unavailable. This operation was rejected; check the dependency before deliberately retrying.
setup.workflow.rejected.setupClosed: The setup window is closed. Re-read system status; do not repeat the old request.
setup.workflow.rejected.validation: The server rejected the setup configuration. Review the current values and submit again; no automatic retry was made.
setup.workflow.error: The request failed. Check configuration or connectivity before a deliberate new submission.
setup.workflow.conflict: Initialization conflicted. Check the system state before continuing.
setup.workflow.unavailable: The setup window cannot be confirmed. Restore connectivity and read the status again.
setup.check.pending: Checking connectivity without creating schemas or saving configuration.
setup.check.reachable: The connection is reachable. This does not mean initialization or configuration persistence succeeded.
setup.check.failed: The connection check failed. Check the endpoint, authentication and network.
setup.check.authenticationFailed: Authentication failed. Check the account, password or access token.
setup.check.connectionFailed: The service could not be reached. Check the address, port and network connectivity.
setup.check.unsupported: This connection method is not supported. Check the configuration type and service version.
password.remote.title: Operation status
password.remote.unknown: The outcome is unknown. Sign in again to verify; do not repeat this change.
password.remote.currentInvalid: The current password is incorrect. Correct it and submit again.
password.remote.policy: The new password does not meet the security policy.
password.remote.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again later.
password.remote.rateLimitedFor: Password changes are temporarily rate-limited. Try again in about {{count}} seconds.
password.remote.rateLimitedFor_one: Password changes are temporarily rate-limited. Try again in about {{count}} second.
password.remote.rateLimitedFor_other: Password changes are temporarily rate-limited. Try again in about {{count}} seconds.
password.remote.session: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
password.remote.failed: The change failed. Try again later.
password.remote.subtitle: Change only your signed-in account password. Session handling follows the confirmed server result.
login.remote.unknown: The login outcome is unconfirmed. Check the current session; do not submit again.
login.remote.unavailable: Console status could not be confirmed. Check connectivity and read again.
login.remote.setup: The console is not initialized. Opening first-run setup.
login.remote.rateLimited: Too many login attempts. Try again later.
login.remote.rateLimitedFor: Sign-in is rate-limited. Retry in about {{count}} seconds.
login.remote.rateLimitedFor_one: Sign-in is rate-limited. Retry in about {{count}} second.
login.remote.rateLimitedFor_other: Sign-in is rate-limited. Retry in about {{count}} seconds.
login.remote.invalid: Incorrect credentials, or this account cannot sign in.
login.remote.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Confirm your sign-in status again.
account.invalidRole: Choose the administrator or viewer role.
management.title: Account and role management
management.denied: Only the current administrator can manage accounts and roles.
management.pending: Submitting. Do not repeat this operation.
management.success: The server confirmed the change. Current reads are refreshed.
management.unknown: The outcome is unconfirmed. Inspect the original operation; do not submit again.
management.usernameTaken: This account name is already in use. Choose another name.
management.lastAdmin: The last active administrator cannot be disabled or demoted.
management.builtIn: The built-in administrator cannot be disabled or demoted.
management.conflict: The account changed elsewhere. Read the latest revision before continuing; local edits are not silently rebased.
management.failed: The operation was rejected or could not complete. Check inputs and permissions.
management.read.refreshing: Refreshing. Showing the last successfully read data.
management.read.empty: No account found. Another account will not be selected automatically.
management.read.failed: Reading failed. You can retry this read.
management.read.stale: Refresh failed. The displayed data may be stale.
management.read.partial: Account information is incomplete. Do not infer administrative privileges.
management.disableImpact: Disabling blocks sign-in and immediately revokes the account's existing sessions.
management.enableImpact: Enabling allows sign-in with the current role.
management.roleImpact: The server validates role changes and updates the target account's permissions; the next identity check returns the new role. Selecting a role does not save it.
management.chooseAccount: Select an explicit account, or open it from account management.
management.unsavedDescription: Switching accounts discards the current selection. Continue?
management.useOwnPassword: You can reset this account's password here and sign in again afterward, or change it with your current password from the avatar menu. You cannot delete your signed-in account.
management.passwordGenerationFailed: Secure randomness is unavailable. Enter a password manually.
management.confirmAccountName: Enter the target username to confirm deletion
management.resetImpact: Revoke all sessions and invalidate the old password. Disabled accounts remain disabled.
management.deleteImpact: Prevent login and revoke all sessions. The username stays reserved; audit and publication history are retained. This action cannot be undone in the console.
